extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: MACS J1149.5+2223 (z=0.542). Schuldt, Grillo, Caminha, Mercurio, Rosati, Morishita, Stiavelli, Suyu et al. 2024, A&A 689, A42, table A.1 'MUSE catalog from new pointing'. 432 redshifts - the largest spectroscopic catalogue available for MACS J1149 and the best available for this cluster. Quality: column q_z; columns Mult (multiple-image flag), s_z, F814W magnitude and r_z (reference) are also present, and CLASHVLT / HST identifiers allow cross-matching. Instrument: VLT/MUSE (an additional pointing beyond the original Grillo+2016 field), combined with CLASH-VLT VIMOS identifiers. Selection function: MUSE datacube detection over the extended pointing footprint; F814W-based continuum priors plus blind line detection. Sky coverage: to ~1.7 arcmin (~0.65 Mpc projected); 90% within ~0.49 Mpc. WARNING: only ~151 objects lie within |dv|<3000 km/s of the cluster, so the member count is marginal for a resolved sigma(R) field and the radial baseline is sub-Mpc.
